add_term_audit.parent_reduction: As alpha_mf -> 0 the internal feedback field vanishes and the effective field reduces to H, recovering M = Msat*tanh(H/H0).
add_term_audit.observable_signature: The response curve rises much more steeply near zero field and reaches near-saturation at smaller applied fields than the plain tanh; for large alpha_mf it exhibits an amplified low-field susceptibility (steeper initial slope) inconsistent with any single rescaling of H0 in the parent form.
